name: Supply Chain TRIZ
description: Same TRIZ machinery with supply-chain / logistics vocabulary — inventory, lead times, demand, shipping, capacity.

parameter_map.Loss of time: idle time / waiting at the dock / dwell time
parameter_map.Quantity of substance: inventory volume / order quantity / lot size
parameter_map.Duration of action of stationary object: shelf life / handling resilience of stored goods
parameter_map.Loss of information: forecast error / visibility gaps across the chain
parameter_map.Use of energy by moving object: transport fuel / energy per unit shipped

principle_soft.2: take the slow supplier off the critical path (dual sourcing, buffer stock)
principle_soft.5: consolidate shipments; shared transport; combine orders into one load
principle_soft.10: pre-position stock; forecast-driven pre-staging before the peak
principle_soft.15: dynamic routing; adaptive batch sizes as demand shifts
principle_soft.19: periodic replenishment rhythms matched to demand cadence
principle_soft.24: distribution center as intermediary; cross-docking without storage
principle_soft.26: copying — replicate a fast lane pattern across nodes
principle_soft.35: change the state of the goods — VMI, postponement, pack-size changes

examples: The warehouse must hold more SKUs, but the building cannot grow and picking gets slower.
Lead time must drop, but holding more safety stock raises inventory cost.
